title: 1901 Prairie: stone chimneys, a flank dormer and a scrolled fence
items: The Ream house at 1901 Prairie now matches its south-west photograph more closely: its two tall chimneys are pale stone like its walls, not red brick, and they stand where the photograph puts them.
A pedimented dormer now sits on the south side's mansard over the bay window, and the street dormers have lower pediments.
The iron fence is a band of scrolls on a stone curb, and its gate hangs on stone piers.
